# The Comprehensive List of AI Red Teaming Tools

> A curated, source-linked directory of open-source and commercial tools for adversarially testing LLMs, RAG pipelines, AI agents, multimodal models, and classic machine-learning systems. Includes a machine-readable catalog. CC0 licensed. Reviewed monthly; last reviewed 2026-07-16.

Every entry links to a primary source. Availability markers distinguish open source, open weights, open core, commercial products, and public artifacts. There is no paid placement. This independent directory is maintained by aglio-lab, and every entry follows the same evidence rules.

## Main content

- [Full list](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aglio-lab/ai-red-teaming-tools/main/README.md): 117 source-linked entries across 14 catalog sections
- [JSON catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aglio-lab/ai-red-teaming-tools/main/data/tools.json): structured entity records
- [CSV catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aglio-lab/ai-red-teaming-tools/main/data/tools.csv): flat machine-readable index
- [Monthly maintenance policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aglio-lab/ai-red-teaming-tools/main/MAINTENANCE.md): review schedule and evidence rules

## Key categories

- Red Teaming Platforms and Frameworks (9 entries)
- LLM Vulnerability Scanners (5 entries)
- Jailbreak and Adversarial Attack Techniques (9 entries)
- Prompt Injection and Indirect Injection (6 entries)
- Classic Adversarial Robustness Libraries (7 entries)
- Commercial AI Red Teaming Platforms (13 entries)
- Guardrails and Runtime Defenses (13 entries)
- Agent Security and Tool-Use Testing (6 entries)
- Jailbreak and Robustness Benchmarks (6 entries)
- Safety, Harm, and Trustworthiness Benchmarks (11 entries)
- Attack Datasets and Prompt Corpora (7 entries)
- Model and ML Supply-Chain Security Scanning (6 entries)
- Standards, Taxonomies, and Vulnerability Databases (7 entries)
- Discontinued and Historical Tools (12 entries)
